eras.title: Fish along an earthen wall
eras.caption: At Chan Chan, fish and net-like patterns decorate the walls of adobe compounds. The motifs connect the Chimú capital with the Pacific coast nearby, while the narrow passages show how carefully access was controlled within its great enclosures.
